entries.name: Centaur - Stampede
entries.detail: Stun duration increased from 0.75s to 1s.

entries.name: Element - Elemental Essence
entries.detail: (4) Elements: Petrification duration increased from 3s to 4s

entries.name: Warrior  - Fortified Armor
entries.detail: (6) Warriors: Armor bonus increased from 11 to 12.

entries.name: God - Overweening Superiority
entries.detail: (2)(4) Gods: Cooldown reduction increased from -30% to -40%.

entries.name: Orc - Battle Hardened
entries.detail: (4) Orcs: Max HP bonus increased from 300 to 400.

entries.name: Assassin - Coup de Grace
entries.detail: (9) Assassins: Auto-backstab jump refresh cooldown changed from fixed 10s to random 8~10s.

entries.name: Kobold - Divided We Stand
entries.detail: (4) Kobolds: Shapeshift cast time decreased from random 5~7s to random 4~6s.

entries.name: Shadow Shaman - Fiends Grasp
entries.detail: Duration reduced from 4/6/8s to 3/5/7s.

entries.name: Dark Willow - Bramble Maze
entries.detail: Root duration increased from 3/2/2s to 4/3/3s.

entries.name: Oracle - Rain of Destiny
entries.detail: The rain now centers on the caster. Area of effect increased from 250/300/400 to 300/350/450. Affected allied units gain +10%/20%/30% Lucky Aura.

entries.name: Sniper, Windranger, Primal Beast, Shadow Fiend
entries.detail: Base attack damage rebalanced from 60/60/75/85 to 55/55/65/95.

entries.name: Lycan (Human/Beast/Hunter)
entries.detail: Class corrected from Warrior to Hunter.

entries.name: Venomancer - Plague Ward
entries.detail: Wards now prioritize targets without the Venom debuff.

entries.name: Enigma - Midnight Pulse
entries.detail: Duration rebalanced from 4/5/7s to 5/5/6s.

entries.name: Storm Spirit - Static Storm
entries.detail: Maximum damage reduced from 150/225/300 to 150/200/250.

entries.name: Medusa
entries.detail: Number of Split Shot targets increased from 2/3/4 to 3/3/4.

entries.name: Alchemist - Chemical Rage
entries.detail: Now grants an additional 250/500/1000 maximum HP.

entries.name: Warlock - Chaotic Offering
entries.detail: Stun radius of Infernos reduced from 300 to 205 (1 tile). Inferno duration lowered from random 5~15s to random 5~10s.

entries.name: Troll Warlord - Fervor
entries.detail: Internal cooldown of throwing axes reduced from 3/2/1s to 2.5/1.5/0.5s.

entries.name: Underlord - Fiend's Gate
entries.detail: Summon interval adjusted from flat 4s to 5.5/4.5/4s.

entries.name: Satanic
entries.detail: Added passive: The carrier counts as a Faceless unit. Active lifesteal potency slightly nerfed.

entries.name: Lucid Star
entries.detail: Dynamic chance rebalanced from 22%/20%/18%/16%/14% to 25%/22%/19%/16%/13%.

entries.name: Magic Seed
entries.detail: Chances keep increasing by 3% instead of 2% per round.

entries.name: S43 Stella Ranger(May, 1st - June, 30th) Awards will be granted as follows:

entries.detail:
Badges will be settled by the final ranking of the Season. All other awards will be settled by the highest rank in Season.

The last day of the season will be a casual day to settle the awards. You can play casual games without rankings. New Season S44 Crimson Monk Season will be kicked off on July 1st, 2026.
